reversal_definition.genuine_reversal: r > 1; latest r <= t; offset = t - r; initial block excluded
reversal_definition.accuracy: hard choice agrees with realized outcome (a_correct)
reversal_definition.follow_better: hard choice follows scheduled better advisor (p_a > 0.5); p_a = 0.5 excluded
reversal_definition.aggregation: per-copy scores averaged within episode pair, then equal weight over pairs
reversal_definition.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap CI over episode pairs; 10000 resamples, seed 0
